card.name: Small words before desert place names
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, of, near, as, in) in passages about deserts, such as the Namib, Libyan Desert or Utah desert, right before a desert location or feature is named.

modes.label: Linking word before desert place
modes.description: A word like the, of, near or in that sits just ahead of a named desert site or region.

modes.label: Inside desert description
modes.description: A word within a description of a desert, including the word sand itself before dunes.
modes.example: The Libyan Desert is characterized by massive<< sand>> dunes and eight great depressions.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward desert and sand words such as sand, sands, desert and their Chinese equivalents.
card.plain: It notices small words in desert-geography text where a desert or sand term is likely to come next.
